review_type: Independent adversarial source and affected behavior review

resolved_findings.issue: Failure reason reset accidentally inserted in preview model detection, allowing old LINK_DROPPED reason to survive later results
resolved_findings.resolution: Moved reset to background refresh after generation guard and before fetch; regression verifies success and unclassified timeout/runtime failure clear reason.

resolved_findings.issue: New log escalation mock omitted native closed probe, yielding alternating keep/disconnect signatures inconsistent with two-record expectation
resolved_findings.resolution: Mock now explicitly returns closed native state; production preserves teardown flag in dedup signature.

resolved_findings.issue: Root identified exact setup-drop budget could reset after same-target absent or unknown error, leaving intermittent unresolved drop episodes at INFO indefinitely
resolved_findings.resolution: Target key now case-folded and retained across every same-target error; only fresh successful status or another target resets drop counter. Added alternating drop/absence/case variant/unknown/third-drop warning regression.

resolved_findings.issue: Root live test found successful event-driven reconnect with unchanged film/battery had no new INFO status marker, causing probe false-negative
resolved_findings.resolution: Accepted current disconnect callback clears status-log signature after token/generation/selection/stopping guards. Pending or retired replies still cannot publish/log freshness; first accepted recovery logs INFO once, then steady identical status is DEBUG.

checks.exact_setup_drop_classification: Only InstantLinkBleError code ERROR_BLE with complete exact canonical native detail qualifies. Suffix, auth-containing, foreign, unresolved readiness and missing detail remain warnings.
checks.warning_preservation: Third same-target exact setup drop within an unresolved episode escalates to WARNING, even across intervening absence, unknown faults, session teardown and case-variant aliases. Unknown/auth/protocol faults remain WARNING themselves. Dedup severity, detail, stage, target and teardown state prevent distinct failures colliding; fresh status or genuinely changed target resets episode.
checks.log_ownership: Per-exception backend reported/coalesced flag explicitly permits UI DEBUG mirror. Providers without flag retain UI WARNING; generic errors do not silently inherit ownership.
checks.native_error_evidence: Connect terminal detail and current phase retained across backend/provider/controller; BLE failure no longer fabricates absent-scan diagnostics.
checks.retry_bound: Fake clock verifies setup-drop four-failure cadence 0,1.25,2.5,32.5,62.5 seconds and alternating drop/absence does not renew budget; ordinary absent startup unchanged.
checks.freshness: No ready metadata bypass; late success with pending disconnect does not publish fresh state. Generation checks and watch token rejection retained.
checks.recovery_serialization: Pending disconnect event owns cleanup before failure-driven bond/silent-link tasks can overlap. Cached session close, failed status lease release, active-link bond gates retained.
checks.cancellation: Shielded native worker ownership, repeated cancellation deadline, initial-status fresh ownership, delayed watch and generation retirement tests passed.
checks.native_transport_and_ffi: No Rust core/FFI edits; physical teardown verification, cancellation poisoning, no replay, protocol/image paths unchanged.
checks.recovery_log_marker: Current accepted disconnect invalidates previous log signature without changing heartbeat timer, device/session state or cadence. Rejected callbacks cannot mutate signature. Pending old reply cannot consume reset. Next fresh status emits INFO even if values match old episode; following identical status DEBUG. Regression includes stale callback and existing retired/paused/replaced/stopping guards.

boundaries: Source review and local mocked tests only; root owns live installed no-film validation.
Narrow setup-drop INFO classification and bounded recovery do not assert elimination of Bluetooth radio failures or improvement on controlled hardware timings.
Unknown/auth/protocol failures intentionally remain warnings; native terminal details are absent for some established status errors and those remain warnings.
Per-generation recovery budget resets only at a new poll or fresh status; external generation replacement keeps existing lifecycle semantics.
